spec: CSS Text Level 3 §5.2 line-break property; Unicode UAX #14 LB25 PR × ID; CSS Sizing Level 3 min-content contribution; CSS Grid Level 1 track sizing
independentRules: U+FF04 FULLWIDTH DOLLAR SIGN is a fullwidth East Asian PR prefix.
For loose line breaking, a break after a fullwidth PR prefix is allowed for Chinese/Japanese writing systems.
The corresponding break is forbidden for normal line breaking and for non-CJK writing systems under loose.
The boundary before U+FF04 is allowed; the boundary after it remains unbreakable under UAX #14 LB25 unless CSS Text loose Japanese tailoring adds the break.
The minimum-content inline size is the largest unbreakable segment; the auto row is 10px per wrapped line at 10px line-height.
